guard: a directed DM reaching a busy Jcode session is accepted through soft_interrupt even when the host is not inside drive() or session_status pulses idle, and a growing automatic queue is published on presence activity
why: The remaining #1075 seats were busy without a Cotal-owned drive(), or had session_status idle
while run() was still open. Sender publish succeeded; the recipient Harness never saw the DM.
The fixture grades recipient observation plus an external presence activity line, not sender ack.
M1 keeps Cotal-owned drive() steering but restores the TUI-owned skip (sessionBusy -> driving).
M2 restores the inner turnActive abort so an advisory idle pulse during drive() drops the DM.
M3 keeps delivery but clears the presence activity string, so the queue is invisible from outside.
M4 restores the initial drive's bare working status, so its first uncommitted batch is invisible.

mutations.name: M1 steer only while drive() owns the provider
mutations.expectRed: a DM during a TUI-owned working session reaches the recipient session (#1075)
mutations.cell: a DM during a TUI-owned working session reaches the recipient session (#1075)

mutations.name: M2 abort steer when session_status reports idle
mutations.expectRed: a DM during advisory idle inside a live Cotal-owned run reaches the recipient session (#1075)
mutations.cell: a DM during advisory idle inside a live Cotal-owned run reaches the recipient session (#1075)

mutations.name: M3 do not publish queue growth during a busy session
mutations.expectRed: presence activity names the growing automatic inbound queue (#1075)
mutations.cell: presence activity names the growing automatic inbound queue (#1075)

mutations.name: M4 do not publish the initial drive batch
mutations.expectRed: presence activity names the initial automatic inbound batch while its run is open (#1075)
mutations.cell: presence activity names the initial automatic inbound batch while its run is open (#1075)
